answer: Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 2 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, thus paying the knoll bond on all of them and exposing each to the opal slash. Because the onyx audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. A 454 account operation therefore ties up 8 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
